case.believed: fast-glob's default, sync, and stream APIs return interchangeable arrays with duplicate paths when patterns overlap.
contract: The default fast-glob function returns a Promise whose resolved path strings honor ignore rules, default dot-directory exclusion, and unique de-duplication across overlapping patterns.
fg.sync returns an array immediately and produces the same de-duplicated matches as the async default function.
fg.stream returns a Node readable stream rather than a Promise and yields the same matches.
fg.stream with objectMode and stats yields Entry objects whose path is a string and whose stats identify a file.
Result traversal order is not assumed; sorting all three modes produces the same exact path set.
case.goal: Prove fast-glob 3.3.3 async, sync, and stream APIs return the same de-duplicated local matches while preserving each API's distinct return type and Entry object mode.
